title: An Eagle Killed a Deer at Least 7 Times Heavier Than Itself

scenes.text: This eagle killed a deer seven times heavier.
A camera trap in Russia caught it in December 2011.
The eagle weighs about nine to 14 pounds.
The young sika deer weighed 88 to 100 pounds.
The eagle struck its back, and the deer struggled and tired.
Researchers called it the first recorded eagle kill of a sika deer.

description:
A golden eagle attacked and killed a young sika deer at least seven times its own weight, caught on camera traps in Russia.
Researchers called it the first recorded golden eagle attack on a sika deer.
Would you believe a bird could do that?
first_comment: What is the biggest animal you think a bird could take down?
